currentManifest.duration_note: numeric design hypotheses; human search and natural failure times unmeasured
currentManifest.primary_score: correct search points with remaining-time bonus and future multiplier
currentManifest.escalation_mechanic: Each five successes freeze and offer cleanup or continued clutter; native target bounds never shrink below64x72CSSpx.
currentManifest.risk_reward: Cleanup removes actual desk pieces and resets future multiplier; continue adds pieces to a truthful bounded limit and increases future multiplier by25 percentage points up to3x.
currentManifest.visual_identity: generated individual stamps and desk tools, code warm wood, irregular unframed native hit regions
